name: Nation Multimedia Group Public Company Limited
summary: Nation Multimedia Group Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, publishes and distributes newspapers, and provides advertising and news services in Thailand. The company operates through Publishing and Advertising, Broadcasting and New Media, and Others segments. It also produces TV programs, as well as advertisements through TV and new media forms; and offers digital publishing services. In addition, it engages in the sale of foods and beverages, including tea, coffee, and bakery products. Nation Multimedia Group Public Company Limited was founded in 1971 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand.
